summaryZh: Herzik Research Group研究真核细胞内大分子运输的分子机制。研究结合生物物理和结构方法，尤其是冷冻电镜，解析相关结构、动态及其原子层次机制。
researchQuestions: 哪些分子机制控制真核细胞内的大分子运输？

evidence.quote: Welcome to the Herzik Lab! We are part of the Department of Chemistry and Biochemistry at The University of California, San Diego .
Research in our lab focuses on elucidating the molecular underpinnings that govern macromolecular transport within eukaryotic cells.

In particular, the lab employs innovative biophysical and structural methodologies, including electron cryomicroscopy (cryo-EM), to provide an atomic-level understanding of the structure and dynamics that govern these complex biological processes.
